tools.name: apply_timeline
tools.description: Apply an edit to the timeline as one undoable revision. Give `edits` (each oldText must occur exactly once in the printed timeline of `rev`; newText replaces it; empty newText deletes) with the `rev` from the header you edited, or a whole replacement `source`. Edits the person made meanwhile are merged. Returns what changed, conflicts and warnings, or the diagnostics that refused the edit.

prefer.description: Which side wins a conflict with edits the person made meanwhile (default file)

tools.name: export_video
tools.description: Render the timeline (or a range of it) to a video or audio file. Pick a `preset` (see `docs` topic `export`: "YouTube 1080p", "ProRes 422 HQ master", "ProRes 4444 with alpha", "DNxHR HQ master", "Web VP9", "Audio WAV 24-bit", …), or a `format` (mp4, mov, mkv, webm, m4a, wav, flac; default: the extension of `out`) with optional codec fields. HEVC and AV1 need a hardware encoder. Refused while placeholders are pending or media is offline, and for combinations that cannot be written (the error names the fields). Exports run one at a time in a queue shared with the app; the call returns a job id (use `job_status`, `cancel_job`), or the result with `wait`. The result names the encoder used.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

out.description: Output file path; its extension must match the format

format.description: Container: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, m4a, wav or flac

quality.description: very low, low, medium (default), high or very high

height.description: Output height in pixels (instead of resolution)

frameRate.description: Frames per second (default 30, or the preset's)

range.description: [start, end] in seconds: export only this part

videoCodec.description: h264, hevc, prores, dnxhr, vp9 or av1

profile.description: ProRes: proxy, lt, standard, hq, 4444; DNxHR: lb, sq, hq, hqx, 444; HEVC: main, main10

alpha.description: Keep transparency (ProRes 4444 in MOV, VP9 in WebM)

videoBitrate.description: Video bit rate in bits per second (H.264, HEVC, AV1), instead of quality

audioCodec.description: aac, pcm, flac, opus, or none

settings.description: A whole export settings value (see `docs` topic `export`)

wait.description: Return when the export has finished (default: return the job id at once; follow it with job_status)

Pass the codeComposition object ({source, props?, assets?} or {template, props}).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

turn.description: The turn id (default: the current turn)

tools.name: use_project
tools.description: Set this session's project: later calls may leave out `project`. A session started for one project (ove mcp --project) cannot switch to another.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path

tools.name: edit_timeline
tools.description: Run one edit verb as one revision (one undo step): split, trim, rippleTrim, rippleDelete, delete, insert, overwrite, lift, extract, closeGap, slip, slide, roll, move. Later items ripple on sync-locked tracks, linked items edit together, times snap to the frame grid. `request` is the edit as JSON, e.g. {"op":"rippleDelete","tracks":["a1"],"ranges":[{"start":12.3,"end":14}]} (seconds). Returns the plan and the printed lines of what changed; a refusal names a code and the culprit item ids. With `rev`, a request made against an older revision is moved through the ripples made since.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: Revision the request was made against (default: the current one)

preview.description: Return the plan without applying it

tools.name: list_models_local
tools.description: List the local machine-learning models (id, purpose, licence, size in bytes, whether installed, folder). Models over 50 MB install only with the person's consent: in the app's Settings > Storage, or `ove models install <id> --yes` typed by the person.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The words said on the timeline, in timeline order: id (`<mediaId>@<sourceMs>`, stable across edits), text, timeline start and end in seconds, clip id, source times and a filler flag, with the project `rev` they were read at. Pages at 10,000 words (`offset`, `limit`). `segments: true` gives sentences instead. Media without a transcript are listed in `untranscribed`.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

clips.description: Only these clip ids (default: every clip with sound)

model.description: Only transcripts made with this speech model (tiny, base, small)

language.description: Only transcripts in this language (ISO 639-1), with `model`

tools.name: duck_audio
tools.description: Lower music under dialogue as one revision: writes volume keyframes on the music items (ramp down `attack` before each line of speech, `depth` dB during it, back up over `release`; lines closer than `hold` merge). Speech comes from the dialogue's cached transcript, else from its level. `mode` replace (default) rewrites volume keyframes only in the affected range, so running again replaces an earlier duck; merge multiplies with existing ones. `dryRun` returns the planned keyframes per music item without changing anything.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

music.description: Music item ids or track ids/names (list, or comma-separated)

under.description: Dialogue item ids or track ids/names (list, or comma-separated)

attack.description: Seconds of ramp down before speech (default 0.2)

release.description: Seconds of ramp up after speech (default 0.4)

hold.description: Lines closer than this many seconds merge (default 0.5)

source.description: transcript, level or auto (default: transcript when cached, else level)

dryRun.description: Return the plan without applying it

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: An export job's state (queued, running, done, failed, cancelled), progress, encoder, output and error. With `wait`, returns once the job has finished.

wait.description: Return when the job has finished

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running export job: a running one stops within 2 seconds and leaves no partial file. Refused for a finished job, whose file is kept.

tools.name: list_export_jobs
tools.description: List the export queue, oldest first: every queued and running job, and those finished in the last day (all: every job). The app, `ove` and MCP share this queue.

all.description: Include jobs finished more than a day ago

tools.name: save_range_as_media
tools.description: Render a range of the timeline into a new media file owned by the project (one revision). With `replace`, the same revision replaces what the range covers on `tracks` (default: every track except audio tracks) with one clip of the new media: a render in place, undone in one step. The file is DNxHR HQ or ProRes 422 HQ in MOV at the project's size (`small`: H.264 MP4).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

replace.description: Also replace the covered items with one clip of the new media

tracks.description: Track ids or names to render and replace (default: all but audio tracks)

small.description: H.264 in MP4 instead of an intermediate codec (smaller, lossy)
